title: Scaling Laws for SAE Training Data
abstract: arXiv:2611.07756v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Activation storage is often a bottleneck in sparse autoencoder (SAE) training. We study how many unique activations an SAE needs when its total training budget is fixed. Quality improves rapidly as the buffer grows, then reaches a plateau where replaying the buffer is nearly as effective as using fresh activations throughout training. Beyond this point, additional unique activations bring little benefit to reconstruction or interpretability, so the buffer need not grow with the training budget. We describe this tradeoff between diversity and repetition with a scaling law for limited data. We validate it across dictionary sizes and token budgets, early, middle, and late layers of Llama-3.1, Qwen3 model sizes, and BatchTopK, TopK, and JumpReLU SAEs. Sweeps using mathematical text and Python code test the effect of changing the activation source. Evaluation covers explained variance (EV), reconstruction MSE, feature absorption, automated

translated_title: SAE（稀疏自编码器）训练数据的缩放定律
translated_abstract: 激活值存储通常是稀疏自编码器（SAE）训练中的瓶颈。我们研究了在总训练预算固定的情况下，SAE 需要多少条独特的激活值。随着缓冲区规模增大，质量迅速提升，随后进入一个平台期：在此阶段重放缓冲区数据与在整个训练过程中持续使用新鲜激活值几乎同样有效。超过这一点后，额外的独特激活值对重构效果或可解释性几乎没有额外收益，因此缓冲区规模无需随训练预算增长。我们用一条针对有限数据的缩放定律来描述这种多样性与重复之间的权衡。我们在不同的字典规模与 token 预算、Llama-3.1 的早期、中期和后期层、Qwen3 的不同模型规模，以及 BatchTopK、TopK 和 JumpReLU 等多种 SAE 上验证了该定律。通过在数学文本和 Python 代码上进行扫描，我们测试了改变激活值来源的影响。评估涵盖解释方差（EV）、重构 MSE、特征吸收、自动化（评估）……
tldr: 在固定训练预算下，SAE 所需的独特激活数据量存在饱和点——缓冲区达到一定规模后，重放数据与新鲜激活值效果相当，且缓冲区无需随训练预算扩大；作者据此提出并在多种模型、层级和 SAE 架构上验证了一条刻画多样性与重复权衡的有限数据缩放定律。
en_tdlr: When the training budget is fixed, SAE quality saturates beyond a certain number of unique activations—replaying the buffer becomes nearly as effective as using fresh data—captured by a scaling law for the diversity-repetition tradeoff, validated across model sizes, layers, and SAE architectures.
